CustomField.description: Tier-1 completeness flag. Returns a checkmark if all advocate-completion fields are populated, otherwise an emoji warning + list of what's missing. Use in list-view filters to find records needing follow-up. Does NOT block save — just surfaces incompleteness.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Risk_Level__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Referral_Source__c))), TEXT(caseman__Stage__c) != "Not Started", OwnerId != "005am00000DPMM1AAP" ), "✓ Complete", "⚠ Needs review: " & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Risk_Level__c)), "Risk Level · ", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Referral_Source__c)), "Referral Source · ", "") & IF(TEXT(caseman__Stage__c) = "Not Started", "Stage still Not Started · ", "") & IF(OwnerId = "005am00000DPMM1AAP", "Owner still integration user · ", "") )
CustomField.label: Completeness Status
